posts.tagline: Know which GPU runs your LLM, validated on real hardware
posts.description: Deterministic VRAM math and a validated throughput model for LLM inference GPU sizing. Pick a model, quant, and context length — get a real number for fit, speed, and cost across 100+ GPUs, validated to 11.3% median error against 19 published benchmarks. Free, no card required.

posts.name: RatioCalc
posts.tagline: 80 calculators for your financial needs
posts.description: 80+ free financial calculators for mortgages, loans, taxes, investments, business ratios, and more. Totally free and private.

posts.name: Goodbid
posts.tagline: The most generous leaderboard
posts.description: Brands compete for the top. Goodbid commits 50% of every leaderboard purchase subtotal, excluding taxes, to nonprofit donations.

posts.name: Jupikit
posts.tagline: The Finance OS for Serious Builders
posts.description: Jupikit helps growing companies bring their financial operations out of scattered spreadsheets and into one connected system. Expenses, payroll, income, transactions and invoicing come together in one place. Agents handle repetitive financial work and keep the picture organised and up to date. Financial operations shouldn’t become another burden for founders.

posts.name: Settle
posts.tagline: Panic doesn't wait. Neither should relief.
posts.description: Settle is a pocket-sized set of tools for panic and anxiety relief, guided breathing, a 5-4-3-2-1 grounding exercise, a sleep wind-down tool, and step-by-step guides for specific triggers like flying, exams, and medical appointments. No account, no ads, and nothing leaves your device, Settle doesn't collect any personal data at all. The core tools (breathing, grounding, your emergency contact) are free, permanently.

posts.name: RMChat
posts.tagline: WhatsApp multi-agent inbox with official Meta API + CRM
posts.description: RMChat is a Brazilian WhatsApp omnichannel platform built on the official Meta WhatsApp Business API. Multiple agents share one number with automatic conversation routing, a built-in CRM to track your sales pipeline, and chatbots for triage and automated replies -- solving the classic problem of teams stepping on each other in one shared WhatsApp inbox.

posts.name: Kakeibo: Goal & Budget Planner
posts.tagline: The 1904 Japanese budgeting method, now on iPhone
posts.description: Kakeibo is the Japanese household ledger Hani Motoko published in 1904. Four spending categories, one savings promise made before the month starts, four questions answered when it ends. The app does the arithmetic and leaves the reflecting to you. Free tier.

posts.name: AfterMeeting
posts.tagline: Turn client conversations into clear follow-ups & next steps
posts.description: AfterMeeting helps consultants and freelancers turn client conversations into professional follow-ups, clear next steps and proposal inputs. The real challenge comes afterwards: - remembering what mattered - organizing scattered notes - keeping responsibilities clear - preparing proposals without starting from scratch AfterMeeting provides a practical workflow with AI prompts and templates to transform notes, transcripts or rough thoughts into useful client outputs.

posts.name: Look At It AI : AI Mouse Pointer For Web
posts.tagline: Your Mouse Pointer, Supercharged With AI
posts.description: Your Mouse, Supercharged with AI. Look At It AI is a browser extension that helps you understand the web instantly — point at UI, page content, or social posts for private on-device AI explanations and translations in 40+ languages. No copy-paste. No account.

posts.name: Workshopr.io -The Facilitation Platform
posts.tagline: Plan, run and synthesize workshops in one
posts.description: ▎ Workshopr is one app for the whole arc of a workshop: make the case for it, drag the agenda together, run the room from a live console, then turn what surfaced into a readout you can send. 380+ exercises and 50+ ready-made workshops to pull from. Not five tools with an integration story, one workshop moving through five states. No exports, no re-typing.

posts.name: BigCSV
posts.tagline: Open the CSV that crashes Excel. Instantly.
posts.description: Numbers crashed on my 3.2 GB university export, so I built BigCSV. It memory-maps the file instead of reading it into RAM, so a multi-gigabyte CSV is on screen about as fast as you can double-click it. Scroll, search and sort every row without a terminal. Free with no row limits and no nag screens. Filter, column stats and export to Excel unlock once for €9.99 (about $10.80). One-time purchase, never a subscription. Nothing leaves your Mac.

posts.name: culturewar.lol, pay to own a state
posts.tagline: Take a state, fly your flag
posts.description: A live map of the United States where you pay to claim a state and fly your flag over it. Say something loud enough that somebody pays 1.5x to say it differently.

posts.name: TickClip
posts.tagline: The AI shopping assistant that tells you when not to buy
posts.description: Protect your buying decisions, not the transaction. TickClip explains the evidence and recommends Tick, Clip, or Skip without affiliate commissions or paid placement.

posts.name: Google Forms Autofill
posts.tagline: Save your answers once. Autofill Google Forms with one click
posts.description: Save frequently used answers once and autofill matching Google Forms with a single click. Create reusable question-answer mappings, fill text, email, URL, date, time, dropdown, radio and checkbox fields, and optionally autofill forms when they load.

posts.name: Daily Rituals for Couples
posts.tagline: A couples app designed to get you off your phone.
posts.description: A calm relationship app for couples. Short daily rituals, intimacy weather check-ins, and private tools to reconnect with your partner. Daily Rituals is a couples app designed to get you off your phone. Instead of endless quizzes, scores and relationship homework, it helps you find one small thing worth doing together — a check-in, conversation, breath, playful moment, touch, repair or intimacy ritual — then gets out of the way. Open the app. Find the moment. Put the phone down. Be together.

posts.name: Kotoba Forest
posts.tagline: Grow your JLPT vocabulary into a living forest
posts.description: Kotoba Forest turns Japanese vocabulary study into a forest-building game. Start with a 20-question diagnostic, choose a JLPT N5–N1 goal, then plant and water words with spaced repetition. Learn 10,000 words with native audio, example sentences, mock tests, weakness drills, and animal mini-games. Available on iOS and Android with interfaces in English, Traditional and Simplified Chinese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, and Indonesian.

posts.name: Decode Investing
posts.tagline: The painkiller for your portfolio.
posts.description: Every individual stock you buy carries real risk of permanent capital loss: either the wrong business, or a good business at the wrong price. Decode Investing protects you from both. We score every company on real profitability, not popularity or hype, so you know what you're actually buying and what it's actually worth. Daily leaderboard, Lima (AI research analyst on real filings and proprietary data), and AI Agents delivering due-diligence reports in hours. Free to start.

posts.name: Roleward (Candidate Background)
posts.tagline: Stop paying $30/mo for hallucinated AI resume scores
posts.description: An open-source style Claude Skill & Notion workflow that acts as a strict, fact-based career interviewer. It stops LLMs from hallucinating metrics, audits your real positioning fit for target roles, and formats your verified experience into a clean Notion Master CV database. No paywalls, no fake scores — just clean facts.

posts.name: BharatBuilds
posts.tagline: Indian builders, ranked in public.
posts.description: The public leaderboard of Indian builders. List your product, D2C brand, startup, or handle. Rank is the amount paid. No ads. No algorithms.
